mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing future value, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in at least 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation crossing above 3% triggers investor concerns about asset price volatility and real rate declines, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL staying above 3% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent tightening of monetary policy (rising FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE below 4%) signal a restrictive economic environment, reducing growth prospects and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND UNRATE falls below 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls below 4% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index below 105 in a late-cycle expansion signals weakening economic momentum, reducing growth expectations and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO staying below 105 for 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS rising) reflects robust employment and consumer confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises by >5% for 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the industrial production index below 100 signals contractionary pressures, reducing growth prospects and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO staying below 100 for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above historical averages signal robust demand, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise above 12-month averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceed averages for 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% during a tightening cycle signals aggressive policy tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS staying above 4.5% for 20 days.
